title: MCP publishes a versioned protocol schema
why_it_matters: The MCP repository points to a 2026-07-28 specification schema. Versioned interfaces give implementers something concrete to check against. This observation is about the published artefact, not enterprise adoption.

title: SWE-bench reports an open multimodal evaluation update
why_it_matters: The SWE-bench maintainers report that Multimodal v2 is open source with 480 tasks for local evaluation. A reproducible task set makes model claims easier to inspect. We have not run this benchmark or verified a new leaderboard result.

title: Hosted model prices need exact IDs
why_it_matters: Our 12 September OpenRouter check matched 37 of 39 tracked model IDs. Two were absent, and several open weight models had paid hosted rates. The model ID, endpoint and check date matter more than a loose product label.

evidence.label: SOFT CAT pricing audit, linked to the same API snapshot
